purpose: Reusable pre-campaign scientific-history fragments. These are not races and do not define future trees. Species/start definitions compose them with biology, home-system conditions, and physical starting infrastructure, then Adaptive Research recomputes the visible horizon.

fragments.description: Comparable early-spacefaring/pre-FTL scientific foundation appropriate to a mature technological civilization at the 2050 campaign anchor.
fragments.historical_notes: The civilization already possesses mature scientific institutions and a broad modern physical/scientific foundation, but no FTL implementation is assumed.

fragments.description: Decades of launch, orbital construction, vacuum operations, and space-industry development.
fragments.historical_notes: Routine orbital operations have produced strong practical space-engineering competence without implying a mature interstellar shipyard.

fragments.description: Mature nuclear engineering and high-density power-storage experience.
fragments.historical_notes: Provides a credible mature power foundation without assuming practical fusion.

fragments.description: A civilization that has spent decades pushing fusion from laboratory science toward practical power systems.
fragments.historical_notes: Practical fusion is a live research program rather than a guaranteed 2050 mature technology.

fragments.description: Heavy historical investment in computation, machine learning, distributed computing, robotics, and autonomy.
fragments.historical_notes: Automation is mature but persistent autonomous machine personhood is not implied.

fragments.description: Long-standing astronomy, planetary observation, radar, interferometry, and deep-space communication programs.
fragments.historical_notes: The civilization can observe and communicate across its home system but receives no hidden knowledge of alien civilizations.

fragments.description: A metabolic biological civilization with mature precision medicine, recycling, and controlled-environment food production from sustained off-world habitation.
fragments.historical_notes: Supports established lunar/Mars-style settlements without assuming self-sustaining extrasolar biospheres.

fragments.description: Mature experience with composites, ceramics, and cryogenic structures for demanding terrestrial and space engineering.
fragments.historical_notes: Creates a strong structural/material base without preselecting later armor, megastructure, or exotic-material branches.

fragments.description: Large-scale digital governance, logistics accounting, and resource coordination developed before interstellar expansion.
fragments.historical_notes: Represents institutional sophistication, not a universal economic bonus.

fragments.description: Scientific history for a civilization whose persistent cognition is already synthetic/machine-based at campaign start.
fragments.historical_notes: The machine-cognition trait is a starting biological/civilizational fact. It does not require the civilization to have followed the human Synthetic Cognition node path.

fragments.description: A gravity-sensitive metabolic population with long historical experience under substantially elevated surface gravity.
fragments.historical_notes: Current unresolved health burden can expose high-gravity branches; the fragment does not hardcode which medical, cybernetic, or genetic solution will be chosen.

fragments.description: A gravity-sensitive metabolic population with multigenerational low-gravity settlement experience.
fragments.historical_notes: Creates legitimate need/evidence for low-gravity adaptation while leaving the solution path adaptive.
